verdict.rationale: PlanetScale ships a first-party PlanetScale Bot that uses natural language to help users get started, understand performance and fix slow or failing queries. It also offers a hosted MCP server that lets Claude, Cursor and other agents work with its databases and Insights conversationally. However, the documented natural-language scope is mostly help, investigation and query fixing rather than operating the full product. missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can drive full product operations (creating branches, deploy requests, backups, scaling), documentation of the bot's supported actions and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: PlanetScale Bot helps you get started with PlanetScale, understand database performance, and fix slow or failing queries using its [MCP server](/docs/mcp-server) and installed skills.
